title: Container Bookings: amending equipment, quantity, destination or cargo category
content:
## Policy clause
A live Container Bookings booking's equipment type, container quantity, port of discharge or cargo category may be amended on the verified customer's instruction. Amendments are accepted only on bookings whose status, as recorded in the line's system, is confirmed or equipment released. An amendment is accepted only when it is received no later than the tier's amendment lead time before the cargo cut-off of the allocated vessel. The amendment deadline is the cargo cut-off time minus the tier's lead hours, counted as full 60-minute hours in port-of-loading local time, and an amendment received exactly at the deadline is accepted.

Every accepted amendment is logged as one amendment entry on the booking. The amendments counted for the free allowance are those logged on the booking before the one being handled.

- **Port of discharge.** A change of port of discharge is allowed only when the tier allows a change of destination, and it still counts toward the free allowance.
- **Other amendments.** Any other amendment is free while the amendments already logged are fewer than the tier's free amendments, and is charged the tier's amendment fee once otherwise.
- **Quantity increase.** A container quantity may be raised by at most the tier's quantity increase limit of the confirmed container count, rounded down to whole containers and subject to space; the added containers are charged freight under the freight charging rules.
- **Quantity reduction.** Reducing the quantity is an amendment, not a cancellation, and bears no cancellation fee.
- **Cargo category.** A change of cargo category must keep the cargo category inside the tier's allowed cargo categories.
- **Sailing.** A change of sailing requested by the customer is a customer roll under the roll rules, not an amendment.

## Deadline boundary cases (hypothetical lead time)
*Hypothetical lead time of 30 hours and cargo cut-off at 18:00 on 12 June, for illustration only:* the deadline is 12:00 on 11 June. An amendment received at 12:00 on 11 June is accepted; one received at 12:01 is not.

## Allowance truth table (hypothetical allowance of 2)
| Amendment being handled | Amendments already logged | Kind | Amendment fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| first | 0 | equipment change | free |
| second | 1 | quantity reduction | free |
| third | 2 | cargo category change | charged once |

*Hypothetical mix:* if the first amendment is a change of port of discharge, it is logged and counts; an equipment change handled next has 1 amendment already logged and is still free under an allowance of 2.

## Retired wording
The former statement that a change of port of discharge is charged the per-container change-of-destination fee multiplied by the booking's container count, whatever the free allowance, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the change-of-destination fee.

superseded_clauses: it is charged pod_change_fee_per_container_usd times the booking's container_count whatever the free allowance
